name: Hostinger API MCP Server
description: Manages Hostinger domains, DNS records, VPS, web hosting, WordPress, and email from AI assistants through Hostinger's hosted or local MCP server.

skills.name: Search Operations
skills.description: Searches the Hostinger API operations by keyword and returns each match with its input schema, ready for the agent to call.

skills.name: Manage DNS Records
skills.description: Lists, updates, validates, deletes, and resets DNS records for a domain, checks propagation, and restores DNS snapshots.

skills.name: Manage Domains
skills.description: Checks domain availability, suggests names, buys domains, and manages forwarding, locks, privacy protection, and nameservers.

skills.name: Manage VPS
skills.description: Starts, stops, restarts, and recreates VPS instances and manages their firewalls, snapshots, backups, and Docker projects.

skills.name: Run Multi-Step Operations
skills.description: Runs up to 20 API operations in order with multi-execute, passing values from earlier steps and stopping at the first failure.
